data.name: SecretStore_SecretService_Facts
data.value: the keyring your desktop provides, such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet, encrypted with your login password. It's locked while you're not signed in with your password, so the engine can't read your secrets then, such as on a server with nobody signed in, or after an automatic sign-in until it's unlocked
data.comment: Shown on Linux when choosing where to keep secrets. Facts only, without recommending it over a file

data.name: SecretStore_File_Facts
data.value: secrets.json in the engine's folder, protected only by its permissions. The engine can read it with nobody signed in, but so can anyone who can read the file, or a copy of it
data.comment: Shown on Linux when choosing where to keep secrets. Facts only, without recommending it over Secret Service
